Italian PM Meloni Recalls India Visit, Praises Reception

Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni has recalled her 2023 visit to India in her new book, sharing an anecdote about the warm welcome she received. She mentioned that if she were to run for elections in New Delhi, she would receive a million votes. Meloni expressed surprise at the extent of the reception, noting that posters of her lined the streets.
